scope: Independent phase2 learning/clock review, restricted to old public source/development aggregates and explicitly authorized offline pretraining JSON logs

environment.dependencies: Python standard library only; no NumPy, torch, trainer, or optimizer imported by audit scripts

main_findings: Twenty RRC pretraining fits ran; ten selected epoch0. Four of ten selected joint checkpoints retain the original zero head and random encoder.

All twenty final recorded teacher/student total objectives are below their first recorded objective; no gradient clipping or epoch40 cap occurred. This does not establish absence or presence of market signal.
RRC checkpoint choice used teacher+student validation, while SOLID reused only teacher; do not label this independently optimized teacher selection.
Origin-specific scale-normalized MSE and raw price relative MSE weight origins differently. Ordinary WLS is the required strong baseline, not an innovation.
The two synthetic worlds have identical (X,z) laws but opposite raw-risk-optimal constant predictions -15/17 and +15/17.
Finite-state conditional Markov reward characteristic-function propagation is standard Markov additive algebra, exact only for its specified propagated state.
The single retained model hypothesis concerns joint observed signed rewards on the original quote clock; predictable activity alone cannot imply point-forecast gain.
next_step_boundary: One frozen pre2021 support/age/conditional-signed-mean diagnostic may inform the root-run bounded experiment. No such market diagnostic was executed by this agent. No prior failed model or confirmation conclusion is changed.
publication_claim: No algorithm novelty or predictive superiority established by this review.
